name: VELESTO
recent: Velesto 近期获得 PETRONAS Carigali 的钻井合约，将部署 Naga 3 自升式钻井平台；同时 Naga 3 仍被列为待售资产。最新季度（2026年6月30日止）营收与净利同比、环比均大幅下滑。
notable: 获得 PETRONAS Carigali 钻井合约，将部署 Naga 3 自升式钻井平台。
Naga 3 钻井平台仍处于待售状态。
最新季度净利同比大跌 98.9%，环比跌 98.1%。
risks: 最新季度营收同比减少 23.0%，环比减少 16.0%。
净利率由上一季度的 15.2% 降至 0.3%。
近期有多笔大股东（KWAP、AmanahRaya Trustees、Aberdeen 系）持股变动申报。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收 MYR 154.0 million，同比减少 23.0%，环比减少 16.0%；净利 MYR 0.531 million，同比减少 98.9%，环比减少 98.1%；净利率 0.3%，上一季度为 15.2%。

recent_en: Velesto recently secured a drilling contract from PETRONAS Carigali to deploy the Naga 3 jack-up rig, while Naga 3 remains listed for sale. In the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue and net profit declined sharply both year-on-year and quarter-on-quarter.
notable_en: Secured a drilling contract from PETRONAS Carigali to deploy the Naga 3 jack-up rig.
The Naga 3 rig remains up for sale.
Latest quarterly net profit fell 98.9% year-on-year and 98.1% quarter-on-quarter.
risks_en: Latest quarterly revenue fell 23.0% year-on-year and 16.0% quarter-on-quarter.
Net margin dropped to 0.3% from 15.2% in the previous quarter.
Several substantial shareholder (KWAP, AmanahRaya Trustees, Aberdeen entities) shareholding changes were recently announced.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 154.0 million, down 23.0% year-on-year and 16.0% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was MYR 0.531 million, down 98.9% year-on-year and 98.1% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 0.3% versus 15.2% in the previous quarter.
